docs.purpose: Lets an admin check whether a user's stored subscription status has drifted out of sync with what the payment provider actually says — because a billing notification was missed — and then apply the provider's version as the correct one, per product, with a required reason logged for the record.
docs.data_story: It reads 2 tables — `user_profiles` and `entitlements` and writes `entitlements` and `admin_audit_log`. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `admin_user_detail`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `MUTATION`. It declares `database.writes[]` with a `write_discipline` per target (the Spec 122 vocabulary verbatim), its idempotency posture, its optimistic contract and its rollback. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: GET is a read-only drift report that also calls the live Stripe API (subscriptions.list — not a DB table) and never mutates. POST applies the provider truth per product in one transaction, writing one admin_audit_log row per product actually changed, and refuses (409) to touch protected states (deleted / admin_managed) both at read-check time and via a SQL WHERE fence against a concurrent change during the Stripe round trip. admin_key auth is forbidden from POST. Response is a dynamically built products/applied object, not a fixed pick-list. Also cites 20_stripe_web_checkout.md and 116_multi_product_architecture.md. Called via a template-literal base in SubscriptionOps.tsx. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: EXTERNAL SERVICE CALLS: Stripe only. getStripeClient() at :95 (src/lib/stripe/client.ts:22, throws StripeNotConfiguredError at :25 when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is unset) and stripe.subscriptions.list({customer, status:'all', limit:100}) at :96 — reached from BOTH GET (:160) and POST (:227). No Firebase/Supabase Admin call, no PostHog track() (this mutation route emits NO analytics event, unlike /api/admin/users and /api/admin/users/[uid] — a telemetry gap against Spec 33 §11's 'EVERY state-mutating admin action emits track(...)' as quoted at src/lib/admin/analytics.ts:15-16). CENSUS CHECK: census_reads [user_profiles, entitlements] and census_writes [entitlements, admin_audit_log] confirmed; census MISSED `logic_variables` (read indirectly on every GET and POST via resolvePriceProduct, src/lib/entitlements/index.ts:308), and the usual `profiles` / admin_backup_codes admin-auth reads. No SELECT *. All SQL parameterised; no interpolation. Stripe network I/O is correctly kept outside withTransaction (:227 before :256). | Caching: none observed in the route. NOTE: a module-level ~60s TTL cache exists for the price->product map at src/lib/entitlements/index.ts:280-281 and :306-314, so a reconcile can act on an up-to-60s-stale operator mapping. | Other guards / classification: POST refuses authMethod==='admin_key' at :179-187 (403). Target-is-admin refused at :211-213 via isProfileAdmin (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:196). Protected-status fence applied BOTH at read time (:124, :236-238) and at SQL level in the upsert WHERE (:265). CSRF Origin allowlist for POST at src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:70-78. MFA gate INERT unless ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED (:143). | Locking tests: src/tests/admin-subscription-ops.infra.test.ts.
